Commentary.Commentary: We are back! The Pakistan players are out there in the middle. West Indies opening batters, Brandon King and Shai Hope make their way out to the middle too. Shaheen Afridi to start with the ball for Pakistan.
... RUN CHASE …

Iftikhar Ahmed is up for a chat, he says that he wants to continue good form. Adds that they want to play on their strength and their bowlers have the potential to defend this out. He mentions that as a professional he tries to play well in all conditions and applauds the crowd for their support.

Pakistan batting followed the same story of the last game till the halfway mark with Babar Azam and Fakhar Zaman departing cheaply. Rizwan and Haider then stitched together a decent partnership but just when they were looking to launch, Rizwan departed. The wickets kept falling at regular intervals as Pakistan failed to get the boost they got in the first T20I. But Shadab Khan with few lusty boundaries in the end has taken Pakistan to a decent total here but still West Indies will feel that they are in with a chance today. An interesting chase is coming your way. Stay tuned.

West Indies started with their best bowler in the first game, Akeal Hosein and he delivered yet again, bowling with great accuracy and took an important wicket of Fakhar Zaman. The other West Indies bowlers contiued his good work and came up with solid plans for all Pakistan batters and didn’t let the game slip away with wickets at regular intervals. But some expensive overs, in the end, have made sure that they still have to bat well to get a win under their belt today.

So a much-improved bowling performance by West Indies today. Pakistan have managed 172 on the board today courtesy of some late power-hitting by Shadab Khan. But a chaseable total and it is upto West Indies batters now to chase this down.
Just a single. Full and on middle, flicked to deep square leg for a single. Pakistan end at 172/8.
Haris Rauf is the next batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Full and outside off, Wasim swings and misses. Khan charges for a quick bye. Pooran throws it to the bowler who clips the bails off on his end as Wasim was well out of his crease. More importantly, he has given the strike to Khan.
Full and angling on middle, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
SIX! Second of the over! Comes around the wicket and serves a slower ball, on off. Shadab Khan generates enough power to clear the long on fence.
A length ball, outside off. Shadab Khan swings and misses it completely.
SIX! In the air and six! Maximum to start the over, pressure straight back to the bowler. A full ball, outside off. Shadab Khan smashes it, not off the middle and over long off for a biggie.
FOUR! This was a full toss, outside off. Wasim shuffles across and paddles it to the fine leg fence. Clever batting and Pakistan are getting handy runs in the deep.
Full, outside off, Khan works it to covers for one.
Full again, wide outside off. Wasim shuffles and steps back, squeezes it out to long on for a single.
A full toss, outside off, driven to deep covers for a single.
SIX! Shadab Khan doing the finishing job. A full ball, outside off. Khan rocks back and thumps it over long off for a biggie.
FOUR! A full ball, outside off. Khan whips it, this goes more off the inner half in the gap towards square leg for a boundary.

Review!  Iftikhar Ahmed has been given out caught behind and he has taken a review straightaway! The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows a spike as the ball passes his blade. So the decision stays and Iftikhar Ahmed has to walk back. Mohammad Wasim is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! There was clearly a sound there. A length ball, outside off, slower one. Iftikhar Ahmed looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge to the keeper, Nicholas Pooran who catches it. Iftikhar Ahmed takes the review. There is a clear spike and his cameo comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Oshane Thomas

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Second in the over and this is turning out to be an expensive one. A half-volley, on off. Iftikhar Ahmed tonks it over long off for a biggie.
Full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
SIX! Connects it well. A short ball, on middle. Iftikhar Ahmed pulls it over square leg for a biggie.
Around off, pushed to covers for a single.
A length ball, outside off, driven to deep cover for a single.
A yorker now, on middle. Ahmed jams it out on the off side for a quick single. Another good over from West Indies.
Short of a length, on middle. Khan pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, outside off. Khan pushes it straight to point.
Length and outside off. Ahmed works it to covers for a single.
Shadab Khan is the next batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! That took some catching and Rovman Powell did really well. A short ball, on middle, getting bigger on Ali as he looks to pull. Gets a top edge, high in the air and towards mid-wicket. Rovman Powell runs from the deep and takes a blinder.
Commentary.Howout: c Rovman Powell b Romario Shepherd

Commentary.Commentary: Full and outside off, driven to covers for a single.
Romario Shepherd is back into the attack.
Length and outside off. Ahmed gets on his toes as he looks to flick but gets a leading edge to third man for a single.
Short in length, outside off, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Now goes full but bowls it down the leg side. Left alone.
SIX! Well played! Short of a length, on off. Ali stays deep in the crease and pulls it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
A length ball, outside off. Ali looks to ride it down the ground but misses.
Short in length, on off. Kept out.
A short ball, on middle, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A flatter and quicker ball outside off. Ali looks to push at it but misses.

Tossed up on off. Asif Ali presses foward to defend but gets a thick outside edge to short third man. Odean Smith there misfields and the ball races towards the third man fence before Odean Smith cuts it off. Two runs taken in the end. There was a chance of Run Out initially but Odean Smith failed to collect the ball cleanly.
Asif Ali walks out to the middle.

OUT!  CAUGHT! Mohammad Nawaz departs cheaply now! A fuller ball, on off. Mohammad Nawaz gets low and sweeps it hard but fails to get elevation on that one. The ball goes flat and straight to Rovman Powell at deep mid-wicket. He takes a good catch and West Indies are getting regular wickets today.
Commentary.Howout: c Rovman Powell b Hayden Walsh

Commentary.Commentary: Slower in the air on off. Nawaz pushes it off the front foot to the cover fielder in the ring.
A full toss on off. Ahmed drives it to deep cover for a single.
A fuller ball, on off. Nawaz defends it to the off side for a single.
Mohammad Nawaz comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT! So no heroics from Haider Ali today! A short ball, outside off. Haider Ali makes room and looks to launch it over point. Hits the cut shot aerially but fails to clear the fence and Shamarh Brooks at the deep covers runs to his left and takes a fine catch. Big wicket for West Indies.
Commentary.Howout: c Shamarh Brooks b Odean Smith

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, outside off. Ahmed cuts it to deep point for a single.
An off-pace delivery and outside off. Ahmed reaches for it and hits it in the air a little to deep cover for a couple.
A short ball again, on off. Ali pulls this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball, on off. Ahmed pulls it to wide of long on for a single.
In the air...but safe!  A full ball, on middle. Ali looks to go big downtown but miscues. The ball goes high in the air but falls short of the long off fielder for a single.
FOUR! Short ball again and this time punished! A half-tracker on off. Ahmed hangs back and pulls it strongly towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Another short ball and this time little width offer. Ahmed cuts it through point and gets a couple.
Shorter length, on off. Ali cuts it to sweeper cover for a single this time.
Slower in the air and slightly shorter on off. Ali gets back and looks to cut but misses.
Fuller on leg this time. Ahmed works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter ball, on leg. Ali sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, on middle. Ali works it to deep mid-wicket for a single. End of a successful over for West Indies.
FOUR! Supreme timing! A length ball, on off. Haider Ali drives it on up through covers for a lovely boundary.
Fuller ball, on off. Ahmed drives it to long on for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Ali cuts it to deep point for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Ahmed pushes it off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Iftikhar Ahmed is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Odean Smith strikes in his very first ball! A short ball and wide outside off. Mohammad Rizwan reaches for it as he takes his bat away from his body. The ball hits the bottom of his blade and loops towards Shai Hope at covers. He takes a fine catch and Mohammad Rizwan will not get his fifty today.
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Odean Smith

Commentary.Commentary: Change. Odean Smith is into the attack now.
On a length, on off and angling away. Ali looks to push at it but misses. A good over for Pakistan.
Back of a length, outside off. Ali looks to pull but misses.
FIVE WIDES! A length ball and down the leg side. Ali looks to flick it but misses. Pooran behind the stumps misses too and the ball races towards the long leg fence.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Shorter length and outside off. Ali cuts it in the gap through backward point for a boundary.
Shorter length, on middle. Pulled to deep square leg for a single.
WIDE! Back of a length and wider outside off. Rizwan looks to get hit bat on that one but misses. Wide called.
A short ball and around leg this time. Ali pulls it to fine leg for a single as the fielder in the deep cuts it off.
Back of a length, outside off. Rizwan cuts it to deep backward point for a single.

DRINKS! After losing two wickets early on, Pakistan are building on at a brisk pace. West Indies though have done really well to keep things under control and will look to take wickets at regular intervals.
Short ball and Ali cuts it again but finds the point fielder.
A loopy ball, on off. Mohammad Rizwan shuffles and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Placement! Short again, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan carves it through backward point for a boundary. Too many short balls from Hayden Walsh.
Full ball, on off, pushed through covers for a single.
Fuller, quicker and on off. Defended out.
FOUR! Flatter, short and outside off. Ali waits and cuts it to point and the ball races away to the fence.
Outside off. Ali opens the bat face and guides it to third man for one more.
Fuller ball now, on middle. Rizwan works it to wide long on for a single.
A length ball, angling way outside off. Mohammad Rizwan looks to slash at it but misses.
On the pads, this is flicked to mid-wicket for one more.
On a length, outside off. Ali taps it to backward point.
A full ball, outside off. Rizwan looks to push but gets an inside edge to square leg for a single.
Dominic Drakes is into the attack now.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over. A tossed up ball, full and on middle. Ali sweeps it fine to the fine leg fence. A muted appeal from West Indies but not given.
Short and outside off, cut away to point.
Short again, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan pulls it to long on for one.
Width offered outside off. Ali slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Short and on middle, pulled away to mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan pre-meditates as he tries to paddle from outside off but fails to connect.
Another arm ball, outside off. Ali works it to point. Another good over from Akeal Hosein and he completes his quota of 4 overs giving away just 16 runs and getting a wicket.
Full and on off, pushed to point.

An appeal for LBW but not given. An arm ball from outside off, it lands outside off and comes through with the angle. Ali misses his cut and gets hit on the pads. Nicholas Pooran behind appeals but the umpire is unmoved. Might be missing the off pole.
Tossed up, on off. Rizwan pushes it down to long off for a single.
On middle, Blocked out.
Tosses it up, outside off. Ali drives it to deep point where Hayden Walsh runs across and cuts it out. Single.
On a length, on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for one. At the end of the Powerplay, Pakistan are 50/2.
Touch fuller, on middle. Rizwan turns it to mid-wicket for a single.
Another two as this full ball is flicked to deep square leg.
A length ball, on middle. Rizwan wrists it to mid-wicket and scampers through for a couple of runs. Good running.
FOUR! Pitches it up, outside off. Rizwan leans and drives it through covers for a boundary. Well timed.
A length ball, on middle. Ali tucks it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Romario Shepherd is into the attack.
Flatter and shorter on middle. Ali pushes it to long on and gets a single.
Flatter on middle. Blocked from the crease towards the off side.
BEATEN! Slightly shorter length on off. Haider Ali gets back and looks to push it but gets beaten as the ball turns away.
Flatter ball, on off. Ali hangs back and punches it to the cover fielder.
Nicley tossed up on middle this time. Haider Ali defends this off the front foot.
Haider Ali walks out now.

OUT! STUMPING! Akeal Hosein delivers again! An arm ball slightly shorter in length and outside off. Fakhar Zaman skips down the track and looks to push at it but misses it. The ball goes through to the keeper and Nicholas Pooran does the rest as he whips the bails off. Another failure for Fakhar Zaman.
Commentary.Howout: st Nicholas Pooran b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! This time over the fence! A short and wider outside off. Mohammad Rizwan this time cuts it aerially over deep backward point for a biggie.
FOUR! Short and wide and punished! A short ball and wide outside off. Rizwan hangs back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Short ball on off this time. Mohammad Rizwan sways away from the line of the ball and looks to upper cut it but misses.
A length ball, on off. Rizwan defends this square on the off side.
FOUR! Mohammad Rizwan with a good shot this time. A length ball, on middle. Rizwan just flicks this off his pads through deep mid-wicket for a boundary.

FIVE  RUNS! This is quite unlucky for West Indies! A length ball, on off. Zaman pushes it to point and sets off for a quick single. The fielder there picks it and fires in a throw at the batter's end and the ball hits Zaman and deflects it to a boundary.
On the pads this time. Zaman turns it to square leg for a single.
Flatter ball, on middle. Zaman blocks it out.
FOUR! Short ball and punished! A flatter ball, outside off and slightly shorter on length. Fakhar Zaman stays deep in his crease and cuts it through covers for a boundary.
Fakhar Zaman walks out at number 3.

OUT! RUN OUT! Babar Azam departs cheaply again and this time it's a run out! A flatter ball, on off. Rizwan pushes it to backward point and sets off for a quick single. Babar Azam running towards the batter's end is short of his crease as Hayden Walsh fires in a good throw at that end and Nicholas Pooran does the rest as he whips the bails off in a flash. Babar Azam has to walk back early again.
An umpire review for run out. The bails are off as Babar Azam is run out by a mile.
Quicker and flatter on middle. Azam works it to square leg for a single.
FOUR! First boundary of the series for Babar Azam! A fuller ball, outside off. Babar Azam leans foward and drives it through covers for a beautiful boundary.
A length ball, on middle. Rizwan pushes it to mid on. Dot ball to end the over.
FOUR LEG BYES! A length ball, on pads. Rizwan gets across and looks to clip but misses. The ball brushes his pads and races away towards the long leg boundary.
Back of a length, on middle. Azam dabs it square on the on side for a single.
A length ball, on off. Defended off the front foot.
Play and a miss! A good-length delivery and outside off. Azam goes for a big booming drive but the ball misses the outside edge of his blade.
On a length, on off. Rizwan pushes it to wide of mid on for a quick single.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Oshane Thomas.
Flatter and shorter on off. Azam gets back and pushes it to short cover. Good start by Akeal Hosein.
Fuller on leg. Rizwan pushes it to long on for another single.
Fuller on middle. Azam clips it to wide of long on for a single.
Darted on the pads this time. Rizwan goes for the sweep shot and gets an inside edge to short fine leg for a single. Good running there. He gets off the mark and Pakistan are underway.
Fuller ball, on off. Defended off the front foot towards the off side.
A flatter ball and shorter in length on middle to start. Rizwan sweeps it to short fine leg.

We are all set for the action. The players of West Indies stride out to the middle. Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan are the openers. Before the play, the West Indies players' take the knee in support of Black Lives Matter while the Pakistan players' stand firmly. Akeal Hosein to start with the ball.
Nicholas Pooran, the West Indies skipper, says that they want to show better execution tonight and have one change, Hayden Walsh for Devon Thomas.
Babar Azam, the Pakistani skipper, says that they will bat first and adds that they are going with an unchanged team.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Nicholas Pooran (C) (WK), Shai Hope, Brandon King, Shamarh Brooks, Rovman Powell, Odean Smith, Romario Shepherd, Akeal Hosein, Dominic Drakes, Oshane Thomas, Hayden Walsh (In for Devon Thomas).
Pakistan (Unchanged Playing XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Fakhar Zaman, Haider Ali, Asif Ali, Iftikhar Ahmed, Mohammad Nawaz, Shadab Khan, Mohammad Wasim, Haris Rauf, Shaheen Afridi.
TOSS UPDATE - Pakistan have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

West Indies, on the other hand, have been hampered by some of their first-choice players missing out due to a variety of reasons. But it also provides them with an opportunity to build a new team ahead of the next T20 World Cup. Akeal Hosein was brilliant in the last game and there are plenty of other talented youngsters who can succeed at the highest level if given ample opportunities. Nicholas Pooran batted at number 3 in the first game and he will have to take the responsibility and lead from the front to inspire his young team tonight. Can they beat this strong Pakistan team in their own backyard? Or will Pakistan march ahead to clinch the series? Stay tuned.

Pakistan have been in red-hot form in T20Is and have now 18 wins in this format in 2021, the most by any team in a year. They were clinical in the first game with both bat and ball as they first notched up a huge total of 200 and followed it up with an impressive bowling performance. They will be particularly pleased with the performance of youngsters like Haider Ali and Mohammad Wasim who showed great skills and temperament under pressure. With the next T20 World Cup not far away we can expect Pakistan to try out some more youngsters tonight.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second T20I of the three-match T20I series between Pakistan and the West Indies. The hosts, Pakistan continued their dominant T20 form in the first game with a comfortable victory and will be eyeing yet another series win. The young West Indies team, on the other hand, will be looking to quickly learn from their mistakes from the last night and put a better performance tonight.
...MATCH DAY...
